// Icon names that travel through a plain function call or an untyped table.
// The codemod cannot know these are icons, so it leaves them and says so.
declare function mark(seq: number, icon: string, text: string): void
declare const how: string

mark(1, "play_arrow", "Picked up again")
mark(2, how === "deny" ? "block" : "reply", "Answered")
mark(3, "error", "Failed")
mark(4, "close", "Changes rejected")
console.log("error", "close")

export const SCREENS = [
  ["security", "security", "Security"],
  ["recovery", "health_and_safety", "Recovery"],
  ["status", "warning", "Status"],
]
